label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y tú, toma a ti aromas principales: mirra fluida quinientas, y canela aromática su mitad cincuenta y doscientas, y caña aromática cincuenta y doscientas,
spanish: Y tú, toma a ti aromas, lo principal de mirra de fluidez, quinientas, y canela de aroma, su mitad cincuenta y doscientas, y caña de aroma, cincuenta y doscientas,
grammarChanges: aromas principales -> aromas, lo principal de mirra de fluidez: changed the plural adjective 'principales' (agreeing with aromas) to the singular noun phrase 'lo principal de', so רֹאשׁ (masculine singular construct) governs מָר (mirra) instead of modifying בְּשָׂמִים.

mirra fluida -> mirra de fluidez: changed the adjective 'fluida' to the noun phrase 'de fluidez' so the absolute noun דְּרוֹר stays a governed noun of the construct מָר, not an adjective closing the chain.

canela aromática -> canela de aroma; caña aromática -> caña de aroma: changed the adjective 'aromática' to the noun phrase 'de aroma' so the construct noun בֶּשֶׂם/בֹשֶׂם (same lemma as aromas) stays a governed noun rather than becoming an adjective.
readerNote: Chose nested 'de' noun-phrases (lo principal de mirra de fluidez; canela/caña de aroma) over adjectives so each construct noun stays a governed noun, matching the Hebrew construct chain.
